master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production complete vehicle game master: rust red all-terrain 8x8 cargo truck, carrying eight tonnes of realistic cows securely enclosed behind tall livestock rails. Equipment: snorkel and wading kit. Thick dried mud and weathered materials. Approved Swamp Scout premium semi-realistic painted illustration, readable dark contours, rich natural textures, fine mechanical detail. Reference 1 style only; reference 2 strict perpendicular camera and mechanical construction only; reference 3 tire/rim. Facing RIGHT. Exactly 4 near-side ROAD tires: close front steer tandem at right and close rear drive tandem at left, directly supporting load. All tires 1.81 m off-road mud-terrain tires wrapped in heavy steel twin-ring tractor chains. Total length 10.2 m = 5.635 tire diameters, under 16.8 m including load. Secured cargo and all equipment stowed. Horizontal chassis/deck/load, level hubs and tire bottoms. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Real conventional short-bonnet heavy-truck cab; separate bonnet radiator housing blunt bumper headlamp and round-clearance front fender with clean seams. Small rectangular mirror at A-pillar on short rigid brackets. No melted fused wedge panels or floating mirrors. All road tires fully visible; no front grille face or bed end face visible. Wide PNG intended 2048 x 1024, at least 1500 pixels across, generous 5% clear margins ALL sides. True transparent background and internal gaps. Soft even daylight. No text logos watermark ground shadow glow halo scenery. Exactly FOUR road axles in two close pairs, four full tires visible. Front pair under cab/forward chassis at right, rear pair under cattle at left. No additional wheels. A sturdy livestock transport body, realistic cows inside tall closed rails, no cartoon expressions.
